notes.note: Reviewed Outside-client management and consent authority owners against the two hardening changes. Store admission now checks every supplied key before charging; the production listener shares a 403 refusal for guarded and unknown IDs on GET review and POST decide. The map still accurately describes inert outside targets and isolated R3 composition; operator step-up authority is unchanged.

Reviewed separate consent-origin and device-bound passkey step-up claims against createConsentApp. The new pre-auth refusal handles only unknown/outside transaction IDs on the two shared consent routes. Existing device-access transactions, origin validation, passkey verification and session binding retain their behavior; the dated proposal and current-state banner need no prose change.

Reviewed the historical R2b receipts and compiled-refusal claims against the guard/caller/test delta. Earlier 404 status receipts and the named #4125 limitation remain historical evidence. Current guarded/unknown consent responses share 403 across all three auth states and both routes, documented in the OAuth reference. No old execution or capture provenance is upgraded.

Reviewed R3 budget/replay and compiled-release claims against the chargeBudgets and regression-test delta. Every supplied budget is checked before any key is charged in the same transaction. Existing replay-before-refusal revocation remains covered by the route suite. Historical receipts are preserved; no new native-client, ingress, MCP transport or R6 qualification is claimed.

Reviewed budget ordering, release refusal and R2b isolated-evidence claims against both fixes. Admission remains before domain work; guarded consent remains inert. The fixes implement bounded quota isolation and opaque consent refusals without altering the design delivery stages, authority, tool catalog or release enablement.

Reviewed enrollment/sign-in/device-access steps and Outside-client approvals remain disabled. Only missing/outside consent transaction IDs now share the pre-auth 403. Existing step-up targets, nonce/assertion verification, device/session custody and isolated outside review rendering remain unchanged; no operator journey or setup change is needed.

Reviewed consent-channel and device-access API claims against the guard and listener changes. The shared refusal prevents outside/unknown review and decide requests before domain work; no API path, request schema, authority or successful management response changes. The detailed outside refusal contract is in the OAuth reference.

Reviewed paired-device and operator-consent integration claims. The callback is confined to missing/outside transaction IDs in createConsentApp; pairing, inventory, live device administration transactions and passkey flow are unchanged. No Connect package or public contract change.

Reviewed consent authority and public-contract references against the listener delta. No exported package types or request/response schemas change; the shared opaque refusal is documented in the outside OAuth reference, while valid consent transaction and operator-session contracts remain unchanged.

Reviewed STATION_CONSENT_PORT and STATION_TRUSTED_CONSENT_ORIGIN descriptions against the listener. No origin validation, port selection, startup configuration or enable flag changes. Unknown/outside transaction refusal is compiled and cannot enable outside-agent exposure.

Reviewed and updated the budget and compiled-consent refusal explanation against chargeBudgets, the release guard and createConsentApp. EXECUTED: budget baseline 85/85, old charging caught a global 20-to-0 drain, byte-exact restore 85/85; consent baseline 96/96, plain-404 mutation caught status mismatch, byte-exact restore 96/96. The test compares full body bytes and all Fetch response header bytes for no cookie, owning cookie and other-device cookie on both routes. These are isolated HTTP/store tests, not released HTTPS ingress qualification.

Reviewed separate-origin consent and auth non-disclosure claims against the listener/guard delta. Guarded and unknown IDs now receive the same pre-auth refusal for the shared review and decision routes. Existing non-outside valid transactions retain their origin, fetch metadata, nonce and passkey protections. No broader threat-model or deployment change.
